risk_summary.quantity_basis: gross held positions; pending orders not netted

positions.thesis: Waystar is a healthcare-payment software compounder: subscription growth, 108% retention, and 43% adjusted EBITDA margin must keep converting provider complexity into recurring cash flow without acquisition or leverage drag.
A development-stage bet on Project Matador becoming a scarce, gigawatt-scale powered AI campus. Commercial agreements and funded delivery—not headline capacity—must validate it.

Legacy Robinhood protein holding. The GLP-1 muscle-preservation theme does not currently provide a clean BRBR-specific public-equity expression; retain it transparently while brand-level volume, pricing, and margin evidence either creates a direct thesis or invalidates it.

WEAT is a directional wheat-futures position, not an operating-company thesis. The trade needs tightening USDA supply estimates or weather/geopolitical disruption to outrun futures-curve roll drag, fees, and a reversal in wheat prices.

Mosaic is a fertilizer-cycle recovery position, not a clean momentum trade. Q2 still showed a $273 million net loss and sulfur-cost pressure despite $407 million of adjusted EBITDA; reduced phosphate output, lower costs, and $1.2 billion capex guidance must translate into better cash generation before conviction rises.

CF Industries is a nitrogen-cycle cash-flow position. Tight global supply and strong plant utilization support pricing, but the thesis requires Q3 volume recovery and durable free cash flow rather than conflict-driven price spikes.
